current_blocker_summary: Shift 102 traced pinned go-apfs-v2 v0.3.0: apfswrite.fillMetaCrypto hardcodes KeyOSVersion=0 although wrappedMetaCryptoState has a typed uint32 KeyOSVersion at APSB offset 108. The minimal safe route is source-preserving KeyOSVersion injection through typed writer plumbing, or if kept local, a post-create APSB block patch that resolves the volume paddr through exported checkpoint/omap APIs and recomputes Fletcher64 over block[8:]. XID/checkpoint and all adjacent MetaCrypto fields remain frozen.
